rulings.model: The structure (smaller of foreign tax or regular tax, zero if no foreign tax, refusal to Form 1116 when the election fails) is consistent with the text. However, it depends on the 'limited' operand, whose definition of regular tax is in line 20 instructions that are not provided.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained. Regular tax for the election is "your total U.S. income tax against which the credit is allowed (regular tax liability, as defined in section 26(b)(1))", excluding the net investment income tax (i1116 p. 25, line 20), which on the return in this slice is Form 1040 line 16: the additional line-16 taxes are refused by `scope.other_line16` and the net investment income and additional Medicare taxes sit on Schedule 2, after line 16. No change to the data.
